refnamediv.refpurpose: APIs to query factory reset status

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.FactoryReset exposes the factory reset state of the system, as defined by the Factory Reset Specification. It is served by systemd-factory-reset-generator8-related components behind systemd-factory-reset8 on the /run/systemd/io.systemd.FactoryReset socket. GetFactoryResetMode() reports the current state in the FactoryResetMode enumeration: whether a factory reset is supported by the hardware and currently requested, armed for the next boot, or already completed. CanRequestFactoryReset() reports whether a reset may be scheduled at all, i.e. whether the underlying storage and build support it.

refsect1.title: Security
refsect1.para: Both operations are read-only reports of the current reset state; they require no privileges beyond connecting to the socket. Requesting a factory reset itself is deliberately not part of this interface, as it requires physical presence by design.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# APIs to query factory reset status interface io.systemd.FactoryReset
# Encodes the current factory reset status type FactoryResetMode( # Factory reset is not supported on this OS. unsupported, # Factory reset not requested. unspecified, # Factory reset explicitly turned off. off, # Factory reset is currently being executed. on, # Factory reset has been completed during the current boot. complete, # Factory reset has been requested for the next boot. pending )
# Report the current factory reset status method GetFactoryResetMode() -> ( # The current factory reset mode mode: FactoryResetMode )
# Returns whether requesting a factory reset is available (by invoking the factory-reset.target unit). method CanRequestFactoryReset() -> ( supported: bool )

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: The io.systemd.FactoryReset interface was added in version 258.
CanRequestFactoryReset(), FactoryResetMode, and GetFactoryResetMode() were added in version 258.
